name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Flat bench press with dumbbells for chest size and pressing strength.
setup: Lie flat on bench, feet planted. Hold dumbbells over chest, arms extended.
execution: Lower dumbbells to chest sides until elbows near torso level, then press up and slightly inward.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on press
form_cues: Feet drive into floor for stability
progression: Increase weight or add a 1-second chest pause
regression: Reduce weight or switch to floor press
safety_notes: Control the descent; never drop weights toward chest

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
description: Floor-based press with limited range; shoulder-friendly chest and triceps builder.
setup: Lie on floor, knees bent, dumbbells held over chest with arms extended.
execution: Lower until upper arms rest lightly on the floor, pause briefly, press back up.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on press
form_cues: Let triceps kiss the floor without relaxing

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Floor Press
description: Unilateral floor press challenging anti-rotation while building chest and triceps.
setup: Lie on floor holding one dumbbell over chest, free arm out for balance.
execution: Lower until upper arm touches floor, press up keeping both shoulders square to ceiling.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on press
form_cues: Loaded shoulder must not rotate up

name: Dumbbell Flye
description: Isolation move stretching and squeezing the pecs through a wide arc.
setup: Lie on bench holding dumbbells over chest, elbows slightly bent and fixed.
execution: Open arms in a wide arc to a chest stretch, then hug weights back together overhead.
form_cues: Keep the soft elbow bend constant
Move only at the shoulder joint
progression: Small weight jumps; pause in stretch
safety_notes: Stop short of front-of-shoulder pain

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
description: Pressing two dumbbells hard together lights up inner chest and triceps.
setup: Lie on bench or floor with two dumbbells pressed firmly together over chest.
execution: Keep inward squeeze pressure while lowering to chest and pressing back to lockout.
common_mistakes: Weight too heavy to hold tension

name: Push-Up
description: Foundational bodyweight horizontal press for chest, shoulders, triceps.
setup: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, straight line from head to heels.
execution: Lower chest toward floor with elbows tracking back ~45 degrees, press to full lockout.
form_cues: Push the floor away at top
regression: Knees down or hands on bench

name: Wide Push-Up
description: Wider hand placement shifting emphasis to outer chest.
setup: Hands set about 1.5x shoulder width in plank position.
execution: Lower chest between hands, press up keeping body rigid.
safety_notes: Skip if shoulders pinch

name: Decline Push-Up
description: Feet-elevated push-up adding load and biasing upper chest and front delts.
setup: Feet on flat bench, hands on floor slightly wider than shoulders.
execution: Lower chest to floor holding one straight body line, press up.

name: Deficit Push-Up
description: Hands elevated on hex dumbbells for extended range and deeper chest stretch.
setup: Grip two hex dumbbells as handles, shoulder width apart.
execution: Lower chest below hand level into deep stretch, press up explosively.
form_cues: Stabilize bells so they cannot roll
safety_notes: Hex flat-sided dumbbells only

name: Archer Push-Up
description: Asymmetric push-up loading one side heavily; bridge toward one-arm push-ups.
setup: Very wide hands. Shift weight over one arm, other arm nearly straight.
execution: Bend the loaded elbow to bring chest toward that hand while straight arm stays extended; alternate sides.
form_cues: Straight arm is a rail, does not bend
progression: Reduce help from straight arm toward one-arm push-up

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Close-hand push-up maximizing triceps activation with strong chest involvement.
setup: Hands together under sternum forming a diamond with thumbs and index fingers.
execution: Lower until chest touches hands, press up with elbows brushing ribs.
safety_notes: Use fists or handles if wrists complain

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Row
description: Horizontal pull targeting lats and upper back.
setup: Place left knee and left hand on bench. Right foot flat on floor. Hold dumbbell in right hand with arm extended.
execution: Pull dumbbell toward hip, squeezing shoulder blade. Lower with control. Keep torso parallel to floor.
breathing: Exhale on pull, inhale on lower
common_mistakes: Pulling to chest instead of hip
regression: Use lighter dumbbell, reduce range of motion
safety_notes: Keep back flat
Avoid if lower back injury

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
description: Bilateral hinge-position row building mid-back thickness and lat strength.
setup: Hinge at hips to roughly 45 degrees or parallel, dumbbells hanging under shoulders.
execution: Row both dumbbells to lower ribs driving elbows past the torso, then lower under control.
breathing: Exhale on pull, inhale on lower
common_mistakes: Standing up as reps get hard
safety_notes: Stop if the lower back rounds under fatigue

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
description: Face-down row on flat bench eliminating lower back strain for pure upper-back pulling.
setup: Lie chest-down on flat bench, dumbbells hanging beneath shoulders, toes on floor for support.
execution: Row both dumbbells until upper arms pass torso line, squeeze shoulder blades, lower slowly.
breathing: Exhale on row, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Seal Row
description: Strict face-down row on an elevated bench; zero cheating, maximum lat growth.
setup: Elevate a flat bench on sturdy supports so arms hang freely. Lie prone, chest supported, dumbbells hanging straight down.
execution: Row dumbbells to lower chest squeezing blades hard, control down to full dead hang. Body stays pinned.
breathing: Exhale on row, inhale on lower
common_mistakes: Pressing toes into floor for help
safety_notes: Verify the elevation setup is completely stable before loading

name: Dumbbell Dead-Stop Row
description: Each rep starts from a dead stop on the floor, killing momentum and building pulling power.
setup: Hinge over with a flat back, dumbbells resting on floor directly under shoulders.
execution: Explosively row both dumbbells to the ribs, return fully to the floor, reset lats, repeat.
breathing: Brace, exhale each pull, re-inhale at reset
safety_notes: Neutral spine mandatory; hinge-position lift

name: Renegade Row
description: Plank-position alternating rows fusing back work with anti-rotation core training.
setup: Hex dumbbells under shoulders in high plank, feet wider than hips for stability.
execution: Row one dumbbell to the hip resisting rotation through hips and shoulders; lower; alternate.
breathing: Exhale each row, steady breaths between
common_mistakes: Weight too heavy for plank quality
progression: Narrower feet or push-up between rows
safety_notes: Hex dumbbells only; round heads roll

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: Classic V-taper builder: overhead arc stretching and contracting the lats.
setup: Lie across bench with head and upper back supported, hips low. Hold one dumbbell vertically in both hands over chest, arms nearly straight.
execution: Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until the lats stretch big, then pull it back over the chest.
breathing: Deep inhale on stretch, exhale on pull-over
form_cues: Ribs down, core braced for the lower back
common_mistakes: Elbow bend turning it into an extension
progression: Heavier bell or two-second stretch pause
safety_notes: Stop range at any shoulder impingement feeling

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
description: Unilateral pullover allowing greater stretch and fixing left-right lat imbalances.
setup: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell extended over chest in one hand; free hand stabilizes on bench or rib cage.
execution: Arc the dumbbell back and slightly out until the working lat stretches, sweep it back overhead.
breathing: Inhale on stretch, exhale on pull
progression: More load or slower stretch phase

name: Inverted Row
description: Bodyweight horizontal pull using a sturdy table edge; scalable lat and upper-back builder.
setup: Grip a fixed, sturdy table edge with body straight underneath, heels on floor, arms extended.
execution: Pull chest to the edge keeping the body rigid like a moving plank, squeeze shoulder blades, lower under control.
breathing: Exhale on pull, inhale on lower
progression: Feet on bench or weighted backpack
regression: Walk feet closer / steeper body angle
safety_notes: Test the table holds your full bodyweight before the first rep

name: Superman Pull
description: Prone bodyweight pull training lower traps, rhomboids, and spinal erectors together.
setup: Lie face down, arms extended overhead, legs straight.
execution: Lift chest and legs slightly, then pull elbows down and back to the ribs, extend arms again.
breathing: Exhale on pull, inhale on extension
safety_notes: Keep contractions gentle with lower-back issues

name: Prone Y-Raise
description: Floor Y-raise targeting lower traps for scapular health and upright posture.
setup: Lie face down, arms overhead forming a Y, thumbs up.
execution: Raise both arms toward the ceiling by squeezing lower shoulder blades, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Flye
description: Key rear-deltoid and upper-back isolation; essential counterbalance to pressing.
setup: Hinge forward (or lie chest-down on bench) with dumbbells hanging, palms facing each other.
execution: Raise arms out wide to shoulder height with soft elbows, squeeze rear delts, lower slowly.
progression: Add weight or two-second top squeeze

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: Vertical scapular elevation filling out the yoke with upper-trap development.
setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
execution: Elevate shoulders straight toward the ears, pause at the top, lower to a full stretch.
form_cues: Straight up and down, no rolling

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: The definitive side-delt width builder; the number-one V-taper shoulder move.
setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at sides, slight elbow bend, shoulders packed down.
execution: Raise arms out to sides until elbows reach shoulder height leading slightly with elbows, lower slowly under tension.
breathing: Exhale on raise, inhale on lower
progression: More reps or weight; partial burnout after full reps

name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Bench-seated lateral raise removing leg drive for strict side-delt isolation.
setup: Sit tall on bench edge, dumbbells at sides, feet planted.
execution: Raise dumbbells out to shoulder height strictly, lower over two seconds.
breathing: Exhale on raise, inhale on lower

name: Leaning Single-Arm Lateral Raise
description: Lean-away unilateral raise keeping constant tension and peak side-delt contraction.
setup: Hold an upright support (rack edge, doorframe) with one hand and lean away holding a dumbbell in the other.
execution: Raise the dumbbell out through a long abduction range, resist fully on the way down.
form_cues: Arm travels in line with shoulder plane

name: Dumbbell Scaption Raise
description: Raises in the scapular plane (~30 degrees forward of sides), joint-friendly side-delt work.
setup: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, arms angled ~30 degrees forward, thumbs up.
execution: Raise both arms in that plane to shoulder height forming a shallow Y, lower with control.
form_cues: Path slightly forward, not pure lateral
common_mistakes: Drifting into a straight front raise
safety_notes: Often better tolerated than strict lateral raises with cranky shoulders

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: Anterior delt isolation complementing pressing volume.
setup: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs, palms facing you.
execution: Raise one or both straight arms forward to eye level, lower slowly without swinging.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
description: Vertical pull hitting side delts and traps simultaneously.
setup: Stand holding dumbbells in front of thighs, hands hip width, knuckles forward.
execution: Pull elbows up and out until they reach shoulder height, weights tracking close to the body, lower under control.
safety_notes: Skip if internal-rotation pain occurs; scaption is safer

name: Standing Dumbbell Overhead Press
description: Strict standing vertical press for overall shoulder mass and stability.
setup: Feet hip width, dumbbells racked at shoulders palms forward, ribs down.
execution: Press dumbbells overhead to locked-out arms, bring them slightly together, return under control.
common_mistakes: Leaning back into an incline press
safety_notes: Avoid if you cannot keep a neutral spine overhead

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Bench-seated press removing balance demands so shoulders get maximal stimulus.
setup: Sit tall on bench, feet planted, dumbbells at shoulder height.
execution: Press both dumbbells overhead to lockout without leaning back, lower to start position.
progression: Add weight; graduate to Arnold press

name: Arnold Press
description: Rotating press sweeping through the delt heads with a unique tension curve.
setup: Sit on bench, dumbbells at shoulders with palms facing you.
execution: Press up while rotating palms outward so they face forward at the top; reverse rotation coming down.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
description: Leg-driven overhead press letting you overload delts beyond strict press limits.
setup: Stand with dumbbells at shoulders. Dip a few inches by bending knees.
execution: Explode up through the legs and punch the dumbbells overhead to lockout; reset stance each rep.

name: Pike Push-Up
description: Bodyweight vertical press; gateway to handstand push-up strength.
setup: From push-up position walk feet toward hands lifting hips into an inverted V.
execution: Bend elbows to lower the crown of your head toward the floor between your hands, press back up.
common_mistakes: Hips sinking into a normal push-up

name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
description: Feet on bench increases vertical loading for advanced pressing strength.
setup: Hands on floor, feet on flat bench, hips high over shoulders.
execution: Lower head toward floor in a vertical line, press back to lockout keeping hips stacked.
form_cues: Hips are highest point of body
progression: Higher elevation toward wall handstand work

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: Standard supinated curl for overall biceps mass.
setup: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms forward, elbows pinned to ribs.
execution: Curl both dumbbells to shoulder height squeezing biceps, lower over 2-3 seconds.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Neutral-grip curl emphasizing brachialis and forearms for thicker arms.
setup: Dumbbells at sides, palms facing your body (neutral).
execution: Curl keeping palms neutral like hammering nails, lower under control.

name: Concentration Curl
description: Elbow-braced unilateral curl delivering peak biceps contraction.
setup: Sit on bench, feet wide. Brace working elbow against inner thigh, lean over slightly.
execution: Curl up while supinating hard at the top, lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Zottman Curl
description: Curl up supinated, rotate, lower pronated: one move for biceps plus forearms.
setup: Dumbbells at sides, palms forward.
execution: Curl normally, pause, rotate palms to face down, lower slowly pronated, rotate back at the bottom.
breathing: Exhale up, inhale during slow lower

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: Overhead stretch-position extension targeting the triceps long head.
setup: Hold one dumbbell in both hands overhead, elbows pointing forward, ribs down.
execution: Bend elbows to lower the weight behind your head into a deep triceps stretch, extend to lockout.
progression: Heavier bell or strict single-arm version
regression: Two hands on a lighter bell
safety_notes: Keep the weight controlled behind your head at all times

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
description: Lying extension isolating all three triceps heads with constant tension.
setup: Lie on bench holding dumbbells over chest, palms facing each other.
execution: Bend only at the elbows lowering dumbbells beside your temples, then extend back over chest.
safety_notes: Never lose control of weights above your face

name: Close-Grip Floor Press
description: Narrow neutral-grip floor press overloading triceps in a safe shortened range.
setup: Lie on floor, dumbbells over chest with narrow neutral grip, elbows tucked.
execution: Lower until upper arms rest on floor keeping elbows close to ribs, press up focusing on triceps.

name: Bench Dip
description: Hands-on-bench bodyweight dip hammering the triceps.
setup: Hands on bench edge behind you fingers forward, legs extended forward heels down (knees bent for easier version).
execution: Lower hips by bending elbows to about 90 degrees, press back up until arms are straight.
progression: Feet elevated or weight on lap
safety_notes: Stop at front-of-shoulder pain; keep range moderate

name: Triceps Kickback
description: Peak-contraction triceps move with maximal lockout tension.
setup: Hinge forward, upper arm locked parallel to torso, elbow bent 90 degrees holding dumbbell.
execution: Extend elbow straight back until arm lines up with torso, squeeze triceps, return slowly to 90 degrees.
progression: Longer pause or slightly heavier bell
regression: Hand braced on bench for support

name: Goblet Squat
description: Front-loaded squat teaching perfect squat mechanics while building legs.
setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the sternum, elbows down, feet shoulder width.
execution: Squat between your knees to comfortable depth with a tall chest, drive through mid-foot to stand.
regression: Sit-to-stand from bench to control depth

name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
description: Dumbbells racked at shoulders for an upright quad-dominant squat.
setup: Clean dumbbells onto shoulder fronts, elbows high, feet shoulder width.
execution: Squat to depth maintaining an upright torso and high elbows, drive back up powerfully.
breathing: Brace at top, exhale past sticking point

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
description: Wide-stance squat emphasizing adductors and glutes.
setup: Wide stance toes turned out 30-45 degrees, dumbbell hanging between legs.
execution: Sink straight down keeping knees pushed out over toes, drive up squeezing glutes.
progression: Heavier dumbbell or two-second bottom hold

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge staple loading hamstrings and glutes through a long stretched range.
setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at thighs, knees softly bent.
execution: Push hips straight back sliding dumbbells down your legs until hamstrings stretch deeply, drive hips forward to stand tall.
breathing: Inhale brace descending, exhale driving up
regression: Shorter range or hip thrust variation
safety_notes: Never round the lumbar spine under load

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell RDL
description: Unilateral hinge developing hamstring flexibility, glute strength, balance.
setup: Stand on one leg holding dumbbells; free leg ready to extend behind.
execution: Hinge at the standing hip extending the free leg behind as counterbalance until the hamstring stretches fully, return tall.
regression: Tap back toe for balance assistance

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
description: Bench-supported hip extension for direct glute loading and lockout power.
setup: Upper back against bench edge, dumbbell held over hips, knees bent, feet planted.
execution: Drive hips up until torso and thighs form a line, squeeze glutes hard for a beat, lower under control.
form_cues: Finish with glutes not back arch

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear-foot-elevated unilateral squat; king of single-leg quad and glute work.
setup: Top of rear foot on bench behind you, dumbbells at sides, front foot placed for a stable lunge.
execution: Descend vertically until front thigh is parallel or deeper, drive through front heel back up.
form_cues: Torso lean biases quads, upright biases glutes
regression: Standard split squat both feet down

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
description: Static staggered-stance squat building balanced single-leg strength.
setup: Staggered stance, dumbbells at sides, torso tall.
execution: Lower back knee toward floor keeping front shin near vertical, press back up through the front foot.
progression: Bulgarian split squat or heavier bells

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
description: Knee-friendly stepping lunge with strong glute and quad involvement.
setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at sides, feet hip width.
execution: Step one foot back into a long lunge until the back knee hovers near floor, drive through the front heel to standing. Alternate.
breathing: Inhale step down, exhale drive up

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
description: Continuous traveling lunges for leg endurance and coordination.
setup: Dumbbells at sides with open space to walk ten-plus steps.
execution: Lunge forward landing softly, push through the front heel rising directly into the next stride.
breathing: Steady rhythm: inhale down, exhale drive

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
description: Frontal-plane lunge training adductors, glute medius, and hip mobility.
setup: Stand tall holding dumbbell(s) at chest or sides, feet together.
execution: Step wide to one side sitting back into that hip while the other leg stays straight, push back to center. Alternate.
breathing: Inhale out, exhale back to center
safety_notes: Groin-strain history: warm up thoroughly

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
description: Step onto flat bench for functional unilateral leg strength and glute focus.
setup: Face the flat bench, dumbbells at sides, one foot fully planted on it.
execution: Drive through top-leg heel to stand tall on the bench, lower the trailing foot slowly instead of pushing off it.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: Edge-of-step calf raise with dumbbell for full-range calf development.
setup: Ball of one foot on a step edge heel hanging, dumbbell held same-side hand, other hand holds support.
execution: Lower heel into deep stretch below step level, rise as high as possible onto the toes pausing at the top.
common_mistakes: Toes gripping instead of calf drive

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
description: Bench-supported single-leg squat building toward full pistols.
setup: Stand facing away from bench height-appropriate behind you. Extend one leg straight forward, arms out.
execution: Sit back and down to touch the bench with control on one leg, then drive back to standing without momentum.
progression: Lower box then counterweight held forward
safety_notes: Limited ankle mobility? Slightly elevate the working heel

name: Forearm Plank
description: Isometric anti-extension hold forging core stiffness and posture.
setup: Elbows under shoulders, forearms flat, body forming one straight line.
execution: Brace abs and glutes hard, chin tucked slightly, hold the rigid line while breathing steadily.
breathing: Slow nasal breathing, no breath holding
progression: Longer sets, feet elevated, weight on back
regression: Knees down or hands on bench

name: Side Plank
description: Anti-lateral-flexion hold carving obliques and stabilizing the spine.
setup: Feet stacked, elbow under shoulder, body in one line viewed from the front.
execution: Lift hips into a straight line, squeeze glutes, hold; switch sides.
form_cues: Top hand on hip or reaching up
progression: Raise top leg or add load

name: Plank Up-Down
description: Dynamic forearm-to-hand transitions blending anti-extension with triceps endurance.
setup: Start in forearm plank, feet slightly wider than hips.
execution: Press up onto one hand then the other into a high plank, lower back to forearms one arm at a time. Alternate leading arm.

name: Dead Bug
description: Supine limb-extension drill teaching ribs-down core control.
setup: Lie on back, arms vertical over shoulders, knees bent 90 degrees over hips.
execution: Lower opposite arm and leg toward floor keeping lower back gently pressed down, return and alternate sides.
breathing: Exhale as limbs extend, inhale return
form_cues: Low back stays flat on floor
regression: Move legs only, arms stay up

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Gymnastics-style hold building serious anterior core tension.
setup: Lie on back, press lower back into floor, lift legs and shoulders slightly.
execution: Extend arms overhead and legs long into a shallow banana shape, hold while keeping low back glued down.
breathing: Short steady breaths through the nose
form_cues: Low back pressed into floor always
Toes and fingers reach away from each other
Adjust lever length before arching back
progression: Longer levers (arms/legs fully extended) or added time
regression: Tuck knees and keep arms at sides

name: Lying Leg Raise
description: Supine leg raise targeting lower abs with strict pelvic control.
setup: Lie on back, hands beside hips, legs straight together.
execution: Raise legs to vertical using the abs, lower slowly stopping when the low back wants to arch.

name: Russian Twist
description: Seated rotational twist with dumbbell training obliques through rotation.
setup: Sit with knees bent, heels light on floor, hold dumbbell at chest with both hands.
execution: Rotate torso side to side moving the dumbbell with your ribcage, not just arms.
safety_notes: Keep range pain-free for the lower back

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
description: Loaded lateral flexion directly targeting obliques one side at a time.
setup: Stand tall with one dumbbell in one hand, free hand behind head.
execution: Bend sideways toward the dumbbell feeling a stretch on the loaded side, pull back upright contracting the opposite oblique.
form_cues: Pure sideways motion, no forward lean
Crunch the far-side oblique at top
common_mistakes: Heavy bell turning it into a shrug

name: Mountain Climber
description: Plank-position knee drives conditioning the core under speed.
setup: High plank, hands under shoulders, body rigid.
execution: Drive knees toward chest alternating quickly while keeping hips level and shoulders over wrists.

name: Farmer Carry
description: Loaded carries building grip, traps, and full-core stiffness.
setup: Stand tall with heavy dumbbells at sides, shoulders packed.
execution: Walk with controlled steps keeping torso absolutely vertical and bells from swinging.
form_cues: Grip until it fails, not before
progression: Heavier bells or single-arm suitcase carry
